title: Hero with evidence cluster
summary: One approved proposition or visual dominates while heterogeneous evidence remains grouped as support instead of competing as peers.

mapping.backbone_relation: one proposition is supported by an evidence cluster
mapping.reading_path: hero proposition to evidence cluster to closing qualification

spatial_rules.spatial_behavior: group evidence near the proposition without equalizing its visual weight
keep qualifications visually subordinate but readable

requires: the hero proposition is already approved
supporting evidence is heterogeneous but related
avoid_when: several propositions have equal decision weight
the hero would be an invented claim
